observations: I inspected the source and the OpenCV overlay. Visible-ink search regions are evidence for the host-authored objects. Coloured layout bounds can differ where native type wrapping or a recorded correction requires another allocation.
Workstream names are bold and owner lines are regular. All four time windows and workstream rows remain legible. The G4 caption wraps before decide and stays left of the dependency divider.
The full semantic map is retained. Table and chart interiors belong to their native parent object. The measurement overlay does not independently judge semantic completeness.
